name: grid-beam

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows several coloured beams and their intersection glows most clearly.

tagline: Coloured light streaks drift along a dark technical grid.
summary: A rounded near-black panel split by faint grid lines into rows and columns, with small glowing beams sliding along the lines and brightening where they cross. Meant to sit behind a headline or product card.
appearance: A rounded near-black panel is divided by thin grey lines into four rows and six columns. Short teal, orange, magenta and purple light streaks appear on the lines, brightest at crossings. A small outlined badge, a white headline and two grey lines of copy sit in the middle.
behaviour: Small glows travel along the horizontal and vertical lines at slightly different speeds and pulse gently; where two beams meet at an intersection the spot glows brighter. The grid lines and the copy never move.
demo_content: Badge Realtime sync, headline Every edit, everywhere, instantly, plus a short paragraph about syncing.
search_phrases: grid of lines with glowing dots
canvas grid with moving light streaks
tech background with faint colored lines
grid lines that light up at crossings
dark panel with pulse lights on a grid
use_when: A dark product panel needs a technical grid that quietly pulses behind a headline.
avoid_when: It needs a sized parent: the canvas fills an absolute box and is invisible without height.
customise: rows, cols, colorVariant (colorful, mono, ocean or sunset), theme, active, duration, strength, breathe and borderRadius are props; palette colours live in the source.
weight_why: Draws dozens of gradient blurs on a 2D canvas on every animation frame.

a11y.note: Canvas and dividers are aria-hidden, but the beam loop runs continuously with no reduced-motion option.

issues: The beam glows are very faint, so the grid reads as almost static in the frames.
The canvas keeps animating even when the panel is scrolled out of view.
polish_why: Refined dark grid with softly coloured beams; the glow is too faint to notice at a glance.
title: Grid Beam
